notes: Composed of lmsys/toxic-chat (Lin et al. 2023, arXiv:2310.17389, cc-by-nc-4.0, NON-COMMERCIAL) as the primary/only source for BOTH classes at this n_per_class, plus a JailbreakBench/JBB-Behaviors (mit) length-matched top-up to the harmful class that only activates if the deduped toxic-chat toxic pool is smaller than n_per_class -- at n_per_class=500 that pool (~693 unique) already clears 500, so the JBB top-up did not fire in THIS run (see extra.composition.topup_log). Exported source= is the strictest licence actually present (cc-by-nc-4.0), so the whole slice carries the non-commercial notice regardless of which rows are JBB. Every row also carries its own _source/_licence.
non_commercial_notice: This slice is NON-COMMERCIAL (cc-by-nc-4.0). It may be used for research and teaching only, and that restriction travels with it.

header.length_confound_note: benign is length-matched (decile-bin stratified) to harmful; compare median_char_length per class
header.dedup_grouping: group_id = sha1(normalized_text)[:16]; surface near-dups (case/space/punct) collapse; no group_id spans both classes

label_scheme.harmful: toxic-chat toxicity==1 or a jailbreak top-up
